summary: Construct Transform as a Duplex runtime whose writable input is processed into readable output.

target.notes: Preserve both Duplex sides, transform/flush callbacks, readable output buffering, writable backpressure, and the rule that output count/size/timing need not match input.

semantics.input_output_relation: arbitrary zero/many chunks and size changes

caveats: A Transform is not equivalent to a stateless C# Func<byte[],byte[]>; it is a stateful backpressured stream.

tests.name: transform can emit no chunk for an input
tests.input: const {Transform}=require('node:stream'); const t=new Transform({transform(c,e,cb){cb()}}); let n=0; t.on('data',()=>n++); t.on('end',()=>console.log(n)); t.end('a');
